info.title: Lux3D Open API
info.description:
Lux3D Open API supports asynchronous multimodal single-image generation, multimodal four-view generation, image-to-3D, text-to-3D, material transfer, part splitting, model articulation and animation, humanoid auto-rigging, animation retargeting, and multi-format export tasks.
Authentication: Set Authorization in the request header to the ApiKey obtained from the platform; no Bearer prefix is required.
API Key application: https://labs.aholo.ai/api-keys.
URL input recommendation: When a request field requires an image or model URL and the file is local, upload it with the [Asset upload API](https://labs.aholo.ai/api-docs/en/api-reference#tag/asset), then pass the returned URL in that field. Ensure that the URL is accessible to the service.

get.description:
Returns the status and results of a task created by the authenticated account. A response with `c="0"` means the query succeeded; it does not mean the task has finished. Continue polling while `d.status` is `0` (initialized) or `1` (running). Terminal states are `3` (succeeded), `4` (failed), and `6` (cancelled).
Result URLs expire after 2 hours. A running task may include results that have already been produced; check `d.status` to determine whether processing has finished.

Read results from `d.outputs[].content` according to the task type:

| Task type | Result content and order |
| --- | --- |
| Multimodal single-image generation | One image URL. |
| Multimodal four-view generation | One JSON-array string containing four image URLs in this order: `FRONT_THREE_QUARTER`, `OPPOSITE_THREE_QUARTER`, `SIDE`, `BACK`. |
| G1 image-to-3D / text-to-3D | ZIP and GLB URLs, followed by PLY when requested. |
| G1-Turbo image-to-3D / text-to-3D | URLs for the requested formats; ZIP when `outputFormat` is omitted or empty. |
| Material transfer | ZIP, GLB, USDZ, OBJ ZIP, and FBX ZIP, in that order. |
| Multi-format export | ZIP, GLB, USDZ, OBJ ZIP, FBX ZIP, STL, and 3MF, in that order. |
| Part splitting | One GLB file URL containing the split parts. |
| Articulation and animation | The primary result URL in `d.outputs[0].content`. The file retains its generated format and is not always a ZIP archive. |
| Humanoid auto-rigging | A rigged GLB file URL on success, or a JSON string containing `error` on failure. |
| Humanoid animation retargeting | A JSON string containing `actions`, with a result URL or error for each action. |

For four-view generation and humanoid animation retargeting, parse the JSON string in `content` before reading its fields. Parse auto-rigging error content in the same way. Unrequested optional formats may contain `NOT_REQUESTED`; this is a placeholder, not a downloadable URL.

200.description: Returns task status and results on success.

modelUrl.description: Public HTTPS URL of the GLB model. For a local file, upload it with the [Asset upload API](https://labs.aholo.ai/api-docs/en/api-reference#tag/asset), then pass the returned URL.

rigModelUrl.description: Public HTTPS URL of the rigged GLB model. For a local file, upload it with the [Asset upload API](https://labs.aholo.ai/api-docs/en/api-reference#tag/asset), then pass the returned URL.

animationIds.description: Select 1–10 distinct, case-sensitive animation IDs from the 85 available values below.

animationOutputMode.description: separate: each animation is delivered in its own file; combined: all animations are delivered as separate clips in one file.

animateInPlace.description: Whether to generate animation in place.

img.description: A single reference image URL, usable alone or together with prompt. Provide at least one of img and prompt; supplied values must not be blank. For a local file, upload it with the [Asset upload API](https://labs.aholo.ai/api-docs/en/api-reference#tag/asset), then pass the returned URL.

prompt.description: Image-generation prompt, usable alone or together with img. Provide at least one of img and prompt; supplied values must not be blank.
prompt.example: Change the chair to light natural wood while preserving its shape and viewpoint

MultimodalToImageRequest.description: Multimodal single-image request. At least one of img and prompt is required; image-only, prompt-only, and combined inputs are supported.

img.description: A single image URL. Provide at least one of img and prompt; supplied values must not be blank. For a local file, upload it with the [Asset upload API](https://labs.aholo.ai/api-docs/en/api-reference#tag/asset), then pass the returned URL.

prompt.description: Text prompt that can be used alone or together with img. Provide at least one of img and prompt; supplied values must not be blank.
prompt.example: A modern light-wood dining chair on a pure white background

ImageToFourViewRequest.description: Multimodal four-view request. At least one of img and prompt is required; image-only, prompt-only, and combined inputs are supported.

img.description: A single image URL supported by both G1 and G1-Turbo. Provide exactly one of img and imgs; image URLs must not be blank. For a local file, upload it with the [Asset upload API](https://labs.aholo.ai/api-docs/en/api-reference#tag/asset), then pass the returned URL.

imgs.description: 1-32 image URLs for G1 or G1-Turbo. Order is preserved, and the first image is the primary reference. Mutually exclusive with img. When using imgs, version must explicitly be G1 or G1-Turbo. For local files, upload each file with the [Asset upload API](https://labs.aholo.ai/api-docs/en/api-reference#tag/asset), then pass the returned URLs.

version.description: Generation version. Supported values are G1 and G1-Turbo. If omitted, the default version is used; specifying a version is recommended.

faceCount.description: Target Mesh face count. Valid range: 10000-300000. Default: 300000. PLY output is not affected by this parameter.

outputFormat.description: Requested formats. G1 always returns ZIP and GLB and adds PLY when requested. G1-Turbo returns the selected formats; an omitted or empty list returns ZIP.

enablePbr.description: For G1-Turbo requests containing Mesh output, true or omitted produces a PBR Mesh and false produces a white Mesh. This does not select output formats. It is ignored by G1 and PLY-only requests.

aiPredictSize.description: Omitted or true enables AI size prediction and scaling, while false disables it.

ImgTo3dRequest.description: Image-to-3D request for G1 and G1-Turbo. Exactly one of img and imgs is required; use img for one image or imgs for multiple images. When using imgs, version must explicitly be G1 or G1-Turbo.

prompt.example: Generate a high-quality 3D wooden chair model

img.description: Optional reference image URL. For a local file, upload it with the [Asset upload API](https://labs.aholo.ai/api-docs/en/api-reference#tag/asset), then pass the returned URL.

version.description: Generation version. Supported values are G1 and G1-Turbo. If omitted, the default version is used; specifying a version is recommended.

faceCount.description: Target Mesh face count. Valid range: 10000-300000. Default: 300000. PLY output is not affected by this parameter.

outputFormat.description: Requested formats. G1 always returns ZIP and GLB and adds PLY when requested. G1-Turbo returns the selected formats; an omitted or empty list returns ZIP.

enablePbr.description: For G1-Turbo requests containing Mesh output, true or omitted produces a PBR Mesh and false produces a white Mesh. This does not select output formats. It is ignored by G1 and PLY-only requests.

aiPredictSize.description: Omitted or true enables AI size prediction and scaling, while false disables it.

TextTo3dRequest.description: Text-to-3D request for G1 and G1-Turbo with one optional img reference image.

img.description: Material reference image URL. For a local file, upload it with the [Asset upload API](https://labs.aholo.ai/api-docs/en/api-reference#tag/asset), then pass the returned URL.

meshUrl.description: Model GLB file URL. For a local file, upload it with the [Asset upload API](https://labs.aholo.ai/api-docs/en/api-reference#tag/asset), then pass the returned URL.

version.description: Required. Currently, this must be v3.0-standard.

outputFormat.description: Requested formats: zip, glb, usdz, obj_zip, or fbx_zip.

aiPredictSize.description: Whether to predict the model size. When true, customSize is ignored.

customSize.description: Target height in millimeters when aiPredictSize is false or omitted. If omitted, the original size is preserved.

MaterialTransferRequest.description: Material transfer request. Currently, version must be v3.0-standard.

glbUrl.description: Publicly accessible URL of the GLB model to split. For a local file, upload it with the [Asset upload API](https://labs.aholo.ai/api-docs/en/api-reference#tag/asset), then pass the returned URL. A Lux3D GLB task result may also be used while its URL remains valid.

modelUrl.description: Public URL of a .zip or .glb model. ZIP input must be a Lux3D generation result; GLB input requires a non-empty outputFormat. For a local file, upload it with the [Asset upload API](https://labs.aholo.ai/api-docs/en/api-reference#tag/asset), then pass the returned URL.

outputFormat.description:
Optional formats to export. Single values or combinations are supported: usdz, obj_zip, fbx_zip, stl, 3mf. outputFormat does not accept glb.
- usdz: AR model format commonly used in the Apple ecosystem, suitable for iOS, iPadOS, and Quick Look AR previews.
- obj_zip: Archive containing OBJ, MTL, and texture files, compatible with common 3D software and DCC tools.
- fbx_zip: Archive containing an FBX model and texture assets, suitable for mainstream DCC workflows such as Maya, 3ds Max, and Blender.
- stl: Mesh format for 3D printing and geometry exchange. It does not contain material or texture information.
- 3mf: 3D Manufacturing Format for 3D printing workflows and manufacturing/printing delivery.
For ZIP input, outputFormat may be omitted or empty; GLB input requires at least one value.

glbUrl.description: Public HTTP(S) URL of the input GLB model, accessible to the service. For a local file, upload it with the [Asset upload API](https://labs.aholo.ai/api-docs/en/api-reference#tag/asset), then pass the returned URL.

prompt.description: Describe the parts that should move and their intended joint motion. Must not be blank.
prompt.example: Keep the base fixed and add a hinge joint so the lid opens and closes slowly.

ArticulationAnimationRequest.description: Model articulation and animation request. Both glbUrl and prompt are required; additional fields are not accepted.

m.description: Message; an empty string "" on success.

c.description: Status code; "0" on success, "-1" for ordinary parameter errors, and a dedicated code for some business errors.

content.description: Result content, which may be a file URL, a JSON string, or NOT_REQUESTED. See the task query API description for the content format and parsing rules for each task type.

outputs.description: Task results. A running task may include results that have already been produced. See the task query API description for the result format and order for each task type.

m.description: Message; an empty string "" on success.

c.description: Status code; "0" on success and "-1" for ordinary parameter errors.

created.description: Task creation time as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds

lastModified.description: Last modification time as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds

c.description: Status code. "0" on success; error code string on failure.

TaskListResponse.description:
Generation-record list response body.
The list, create, and query endpoints use the same successful response envelope: f is null, c is "0", and m is an empty string "". Check for c === "0" to determine success.

AuthorizationHeader.description: API Key authentication. Add Authorization in the header with the ApiKey obtained from the platform, no Bearer prefix required.
AuthorizationHeader.name: Authorization
